build_simul_conv_transformer_model: build a SimulConvTransformerModel for simultaneous speech translation with monotonic attention decoder
build_augmented_memory_encoder: build an AugmentedMemoryConvTransformerModel encoder using SequenceEncoder with augmented memory attention
build_emformer_encoder: build a ConvTransformerEmformerEncoder with NoSegAugmentedMemoryTransformerEncoderLayer for segment-based encoding
configure_emformer_args: configure ConvtransformerEmformer model arguments for segment length, left context, and right context
register_simul_trans_architecture: register the convtransformer_simul_trans_espnet architecture using the convtransformer_espnet base configuration
